blocks.text: **Reading paths.** Team leads read Chapters 2 and 3. Analysts read the whole guide, then keep Chapter 5 close.
This guide is for team leads and analysts who review results each week. You don't need reporting tool experience.

sections.title: Getting Started
objectives: Find the dashboard link and choose your team.
Read the headline numbers at the top.
Check whether a goal was met this month.

blocks.text: This chapter walks you through your first visit, from opening the dashboard to checking a goal.

steps.text: Open the link your manager shared.
steps.result: The dashboard opens on the **Overview** tab.

steps.text: Select your team in the **Team** filter.
steps.result: Every number updates to your team.

blocks.caption: The Overview tab with the Team filter at the top. Illustration (Not a Live Screenshot).
blocks.alt: Overview tab showing the Team filter and three headline numbers

blocks.text: The headline numbers sit in one row under the filters, so you can compare them at a glance.
Each headline number shows this month's result next to its goal. Blue marks a result that met the goal.

blocks.title: Worked Example
blocks.text: In a monthly review with leaders, you're asked whether the team met its goal. Open **Overview**, select your team and read the first headline number against its goal.

takeaways: Pick your team first; every number follows the filter.
Headline numbers compare this month with the goal.
Blue means the goal was met.

sections.title: The Ground Rules
objectives: Name the rules every view follows.
Explain a change to a manager.
Compare this month with last month.

blocks.text: This chapter lists the rules every view follows, so the numbers mean the same thing everywhere.

items: **One number, one definition.** Every view uses the same definitions as the glossary.
**Blue is the focus.** Gray shows context, and orange marks a missed goal.
**Months are complete.** The current month shows results through yesterday.

blocks.title: Worked Example
blocks.text: To explain a change to a manager, compare this month with last month in the trend view and name the largest change.

takeaways: Every view uses the glossary definitions.
Colors carry the same meaning on every view.
The current month runs through yesterday.
